shared.max_current_warning_ratio_message: Multiplier for device max amperage used to mark warning on max stator-current checks (critical remains the device max).
shared.motor_active_voltage_abs_min_message: Minimum absolute motor voltage to consider a motor actively running when computing active-only averages.
shared.active_ref_abs_min_message: Minimum absolute closed-loop reference considered active for velocity-error checks.
shared.active_ref_diff_min_message: Minimum change in closed-loop reference to count as active motion for position-error checks.
shared.moving_velocity_abs_min_message: Minimum absolute velocity used to filter out stationary samples for correlation checks.
shared.min_active_samples_message: Minimum number of active samples required before evaluating a metric to avoid noisy decisions.

avg_current.message: Average stator current of chamber motors while active; high values indicate sustained load or friction.

velocity_error.message: Mean absolute closed-loop velocity error for chamber motors during active spin; higher means poorer tracking.

brownout_count_pct.message: Worst per-device percentage of samples with bridge brownout fault active.

brownout_devices_count.message: Number of TalonFX devices that experienced at least one bridge brownout fault sample.

overtemp_fault_pct.message: Worst per-device percentage of samples with overtemperature fault active (no warning tier, only critical).

remote_sensor_fault_pct.message: Worst per-device percentage of samples with remote sensor invalid fault; indicates sensor/CAN reliability issues.

avg_current.message: Average flywheel leader stator current while active; elevated values can indicate drag or control issues.

follower_agreement_abs_corr.message: Absolute correlation between leader and opposed follower flywheel velocities; lower correlation means mismatch.

velocity_error.message: Mean absolute closed-loop velocity error while flywheels are commanded to spin.

avg_current.message: Average hood motor stator current while active; sustained high current suggests mechanical resistance.

position_error_deg.message: Mean absolute hood position tracking error in degrees during active repositioning.

yaw_drift_deg_per_min.message: Estimated gyro yaw drift in degrees per minute during near-stationary periods.

avg_current.message: Average indexer stator current while active; used to detect excessive load.

velocity_error.message: Mean absolute indexer closed-loop velocity error during active spin.

avg_current.message: Average intake arm motor stator current while active; high values may indicate binding or overloading.

position_error_deg.message: Mean absolute intake arm position tracking error in degrees during active movement.

encoder_alignment_corr.message: Correlation between Talon and CANcoder velocity signals for intake arm; lower means encoder disagreement.

avg_current.message: Average intake wheels stator current while active.

velocity_error.message: Mean absolute intake wheels closed-loop velocity error while spinning.

odometry.total_distance_m_warning_below_message: Warn if total odometry distance traveled is below this value (meters), which may indicate limited motion/log quality.

odo_update_worst_ms.message: Worst observed odometry update period in milliseconds; larger values indicate timing stalls.

swerve_tracking_rms_mps.message: RMS module speed tracking error (actual vs target) in meters per second during commanded motion.

starting_voltage.message: Average bus voltage at beginning of log; low values indicate weak battery at start.

ending_voltage.message: Average bus voltage at end of log; low values indicate heavy depletion.

min_voltage.message: Minimum smoothed bus voltage observed during the run.

max_total_current.message: Maximum smoothed sum of Talon supply current across all devices.

max_current.message: Maximum smoothed drive-motor stator current per module.

avg_current.message: Average drive-motor stator current while active.

max_current.message: Maximum smoothed steer-motor stator current per module.

avg_current.message: Average steer-motor stator current while active.

min_supply_voltage.message: Minimum smoothed module supply voltage; low values suggest brownout-like events.

encoder_alignment_corr.message: Correlation between steer Talon and CANcoder velocity; lower values indicate sensor/alignment mismatch.

steer_position_error_deg.message: Mean steer closed-loop position error in degrees during active steering.

avg_current.message: Average turret motor stator current while active.

position_error_deg.message: Mean turret closed-loop position error in degrees during active movement.

encoder_alignment_corr.message: Correlation between turret Talon and encoder velocity signals.
